about_the_game:
"Bold Idea 2 My Desktop" is a software for beautifying the desktop and managing files. In life, people place clothes, kitchen utensils and other physical objects at home by using cabinets, boxes, etc. to place the items in a standardized manner, focusing on ease of access, beauty, and using neat furnishings to provide a good mood. In the software, the furniture inside the house is arranged, such as tables, chairs, toys and all other household items. And the items can represent individual files or folders. Players can interact with these items to open files, or use editable sticky notes to stick on the items.

The core theme is to simulate real scenes to place and classify the complicated files in the computer, as well as to find and open the files you need, and bring creative beauty and fun to boring work. There are many people whose computer files are in a mess. My desktop is embedded in the computer desktop, turning the desktop into a small interactive space. The files or folders placed on the desktop automatically become more conspicuous items, which can greatly improve the speed of searching for files and also beautify the desktop.

short_description: This is a 3D mini desktop. You can drag the files you use daily or like into it to generate its 3D image, and you can open it through the 3D image~ This is your second "My Desktop"!
